title: Elina Svitolina Sets Up Aryna Sabalenka Clash After WTA Finals Comeback Win
text:

 Elina Svitolina came from a set down to beat Karolina Muchova 3-6, 6-2, 6-2 in her WTA Finals opener, setting up a group-stage clash with Aryna Sabalenka.
 by Sportscape Editor | Nov 12, 2026 | 2 minute read Elina Svitolina celebrates her comeback victory over Karolina Muchova at the WTA Finals, securing a winning start before facing Aryna Sabalenka. · Credits; Via WTA Tennis Elina Svitolina began her 2026 WTA Finals campaign with a comeback victory over Karolina Muchova, winning 3-6, 6-2, 6-2. The Ukrainian lost the first set but fought back strongly to win the next two and secure an important opening victory. After the match, Svitolina explained how she changed her approach and spoke about how much it means to return to the season-ending tournament after everything she has faced in recent years.
 Svitolina Explains How She Found Her Winning Game
 When asked how she changed her mindset and turned the match around, Svitolina gave an honest answer that she was initially feeling frustrated, which actually helped her raise her energy and fight harder rather than letting the difficult moments stop her. She used that energy to play with more freedom and hit the ball more aggressively and with much more confidence
 “I got a bit angry at myself. I tried to hit the ball. Tried to let everything out. Happy I could win those two sets and get a win here. I didn’t really expect it to be fair.”
 She admitted that she had to overcome her frustration before she could play her best form of tennis. So, after losing the first set 6-3, she found her rhythm back and won the next two sets 6-2, 6-2. This comeback ultimately gave her a winning start in the group stage and an important victory over Muchova.
 Svitolina Says Returning to WTA Finals Means the World
 Svitolina was also asked what it meant to return to the WTA Finals, especially as a former champion who had reached the final the year after winning the title. She then explained that qualifying had been one of her main goals since the beginning of the season.
 “It means the world to me. At the beginning of the year I tried to set a goal for myself to finish here. Throughout the year with ups and downs a little bit, I was still having this goal. For me it’s just an amazing thing. After pregnancy, surgery, injuries on the way, it wasn’t easy. I’m very pleased and really proud of the effort.”
 Svitolina's words showed that how much work she puts in after going through difficult moments. She will now face Aryna Sabalenka in her next group-stage match, hoping to continue her winning run.
